Hi Sophie —

Thanks for flagging — we can get this done. Quick checklist so we produce the right files for the consulate:

1) Full legal name as on passport + passport number (we need exact spelling).
2) Exact travel dates (arrival/departure).
3) Role/title for the invitation (e.g., "Head of Partnerships").
4) Confirmation of accommodations and host contact.

I can draft a letter on Redwood letterhead and send a scanned PDF by end of day. We typically include a short paragraph confirming Redwood is covering lodging and on-site meals, plus the agenda high-level.

Regarding passport validity: German consulates generally require passports to be valid for at least 6 months beyond the intended date of departure from the Schengen area. 6.5 months should be borderline acceptable, but some consulates (depending on workload) are strict. If you can get an appointment, fine. If not, I recommend expediting renewal — we can indicate in the letter that travel is time-sensitive.

Can you send the passport scans and the preferred travel dates now? I’ll start the draft and loop in Laura for final sign-off on letterhead.
